title: TS-71 Parallel tool calls: only 2 of 6 results reached the recorded events and the model invented the rest
description: Live rehearsal 2026-10-07, verification turn: the model issued 6 parallel run_terminal calls; the event stream holds results for 2 (sha256 hashes, git log). The final answer contained plausible output for the other 4 (node --test, git status, git show) and said assuming clean. Find whether results are lost in the executor/ledger/host protocol or the model fabricated them. Scenario: a turn with N parallel computer tool calls records and returns N results. Mutation checks.
right_now_summary: Four tool results went missing, and the model invented their outputs.
